# Bundled Traditional Chinese fonts

Noto Sans TC (100–900), Noto Serif TC (200–900), and LXGW WenKai TC (300, 400, 700) are redistributed under their included SIL Open Font License files. WOFF2 is a lossless format conversion of the upstream TTF files, with all glyphs retained.

Sources: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosanstc , https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notoseriftc , https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/lxgwwenkaitc .

Browser aliases beginning with “Zine” distinguish bundled font faces from locally installed versions; internal font names and copyright notices are unchanged. Fonts are requested from the same website only when selected. Text and photographs are not sent to a font service.
